news.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
news.summary: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

news.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
news.summary: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

news.title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
news.summary: The World Bank now expects the region to grow 4.5% this year, but flagged that trade growth outside AI-related goods has been "weak or negative."

news.title: Trade deficit hits $105.6 billion, widest since just before Trump tariffs enacted last year
news.summary: That marked a 13.7% jump from July and was ahead of the Dow Jones consensus estimate for $102 billion.

news.title: The 2029 tipping point: Western populations are about to start shrinking, piling pressure on public finances
news.summary: Moody's predicts that the world's aging populations will have fundamental impacts on the global economy and lead to difficult policy decisions.

news.title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why
news.summary: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis.

news.title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
news.summary: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.

news.title: The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect
news.summary: Wall Street is looking for job growth of 84,000 to close out the summer.

news.title: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
news.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to show an annual gain of 3.7% on headline and 3.3% for core, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

news.title: Private sector jobs rose by 90,000 in September, better than expected, ADP reports
news.summary: Private job creation picked up in September after a brief slowdown.

news.title: The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday. Here's what to expect
news.summary: Data is expected to show ongoing price pressures and consumers who nevertheless continue to spend.

news.title: Consumer optimism slides to lowest since 2014 as fears escalate over rising prices and jobs
news.summary: The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index tumbled to 81.9, a decline of 6.7 points and a reading well below the forecast for 89.

news.title: America's Canadian import restrictions come into force. Here are the products barred from entry
news.summary: President Donald Trump says he expects Ottawa to concede to its demands on trade in the coming weeks, but Canadian officials insist they won't sign a bad deal.

news.title: Australia says more hikes not off the table after raising rates to 15-year high
news.summary: The hike of 25 basis points was in line with expectations by economists polled by Reuters.

news.title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
news.summary: Economists expect Beijing to lean harder on stimulus to stabilize corporate profitability, as consolidation accelerates in sectors facing sluggish demand and fierce competition.

news.title: China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows
news.summary: A private survey shows a rebound in China's exports to the U.S. as companies position for continued stability between the world's two largest economies.
